captureMethodScope: The top-level method describes body-paragraph-spacing. Additional cases carry their own captureMethod.
captureMethod: Copied the pinned pre-edit source and verified its SHA-256 before opening it in Hancom. Clicked the empty second paragraph, inserted grid.png through Input > Picture > Picture with Embed and Treat as character checked. Observed object properties 63.50 by 31.75 mm and inline placement. Set paragraph before to 6.0 pt and after to 3.0 pt, retaining 160 percent line spacing. Saved this independent HWPX through File > Save and exported its PDF through File > Save as PDF. Verified the output filename and filesystem. Rendered the complete PDF page at 96 DPI with Poppler and visually inspected it.

observedDifferences: Hancom uses TOP_AND_BOTTOM wrapping, PICTURE numberingType and flowWithText=1 for the inline picture; Rau uses SQUARE, NONE and flowWithText=0. Both declare treatAsChar=1. These differences are recorded, not normalized away.
Hancom saves XML version 1.5 and its own producer metadata. The Rau-generated input uses XML version 1.4.

cases.captureMethod: Opened a SHA-256 verified copy of the shared pre-edit source in Hancom. Clicked the top-left empty cell and observed the caret and A1 status. Invoked Input > Picture > Picture. The picker showed Embed and Treat as character checked, with Fit to cell and Apply previous object properties unchecked. Selected the hash-verified grid.png through the native picker. Observed the image inside A1 and the row expanding. Saved through File > Save. Inspected the saved XML to verify the picture belongs to A1, with size 18000 by 9000 HU and treatAsChar=1. Exported through File > Save as PDF; the unaddressable save panel required the previously approved desktop fallback. Verified the filename, saved file and closed panel. Rendered and visually inspected the complete one-page PDF at 96 DPI.
observedDifferences: Hancom stores table height 10564 HU; Rau stores 2564 HU. Cell dimensions remain 20977 by 282 HU, with layout expanding the first row around its picture. Table and cell rendered bounds require an independent geometry comparison.

Hancom saves XML 1.5, its own producer metadata, picture TOP_AND_BOTTOM wrapping, PICTURE numbering and flowWithText=1. Rau saves XML 1.4 with picture SQUARE wrapping, NONE numbering and flowWithText=0. Both are inline. These differences remain intact.

cases.captureMethod: Opened a SHA-256 verified copy of the shared pre-edit body source in Hancom. Placed the caret before the first period, after the first ten Unicode characters. Invoked Input > Picture > Picture. The unaddressable picker required the approved desktop fallback. Selected the hash-pinned grid.png with Embed and Treat as character checked, and Apply previous object properties unchecked. Observed the picture inline between the Korean prefix and the period, with following English and Korean text wrapping. Saved through File > Save. Inspected the XML to verify the exact text before and after the picture, unchanged source text, size 18000 by 9000 HU and treatAsChar=1. Exported through File > Save as PDF with approved desktop delivery for its unaddressable save panel. Verified output filename, file existence and dialog closure. Rendered and visually inspected the complete one-page PDF at 96 DPI.
observedDifferences: Hancom stores picture horzOffset=8912 HU with inline TOP_AND_BOTTOM wrapping, PICTURE numbering and flowWithText=1. Rau retains its own inline anchor metadata. These values are recorded, not normalized away.
Hancom saves XML 1.5 and its own producer metadata. Rau saves XML 1.4. Source text remains unchanged, including the period after the picture.

cases.captureMethod: Opened a SHA-256 verified copy of the shared pre-edit source in a separate Hancom document window. Placed the caret at the first period in A1. Inserted the hash-pinned grid.png through Input > Picture > Picture, using the native picker with Embed and Treat as character checked, Fit to cell and Apply previous object properties unchecked. Saved through File > Save. Verified from the native XML that the picture follows exactly ten Unicode characters in the first paragraph of A1, retains size 18000 by 9000 HU and treatAsChar=1, and leaves all source text unchanged. The PDF save panel did not produce a file after window-targeted AX, pixel and foreground delivery; a previously approved desktop click on the visible Save button completed the export. Verified the file appeared and the panel closed. Rendered and visually inspected the complete one-page PDF at 96 DPI with Poppler.
observedDifferences: Hancom stores table height 15364 HU while Rau stores 2564 HU. All four cell dimensions remain 20977 by 282 HU; actual row expansion is compared against native PDF borders, not inferred from stored height.

Hancom stores picture horzOffset=9702 HU, TOP_AND_BOTTOM wrapping, PICTURE numbering and flowWithText=1. Rau retains its own inline anchor metadata. Both declare treatAsChar=1, and all source text is unchanged.
Hancom saves XML 1.5 and its own producer metadata; Rau saves XML 1.4. These captured files are not normalized.

cases.captureMethod: Opened a SHA-256 verified copy of the shared pre-edit source in a separate Hancom window. Placed the caret at the beginning of A1 and inserted the hash-pinned grid.png through Input > Picture > Picture with Embed and Treat as character checked, Fit to cell and Apply previous object properties unchecked. Set paragraph spacing to 6 pt before and 3 pt after, retaining 160 percent line spacing. Accessibility field readback initially showed the requested values but the saved XML remained unchanged; this attempt was rejected. Used the previously approved desktop fallback to focus each visible field and enter the values with actual keyboard events, then clicked Apply and saved. Verified the final native XML contains 600/300 HU paragraph margins, 160 percent line spacing, an inline 18000 by 9000 HU picture at logical offset zero in A1, and unchanged source text. Exported through File > Save as PDF using the approved desktop fallback for the unaddressable save panel. Verified the filename, file creation and panel closure. Rendered the complete one-page PDF with Poppler at scale-to 1400 and visually inspected it.
observedDifferences: Hancom saves XML 1.5 and its own producer metadata; Rau saves XML 1.4. Both files retain their original bytes. Only A1 receives the requested paragraph spacing; the other cells and all source text remain unchanged.
